dog.description_text:
Pumpkin is the sweetest little snuggle companion who just wants to be near her people. At only 11 months old, she has such a gentle, loving personality and is happiest when she’s getting pets, relaxing nearby, or curling up with you. In the morning, when you let her out of the crate she immediately sits down to get pets.

One of Pumpkin’s most endearing qualities is how affectionate she is. She’ll wag her whole tail just because you walked over to say hello. She loves attention and seems happiest simply knowing her person is close by. She’s also a big fan of treats, but her biggest motivation is truly love and affection.

Pumpkin is an easygoing girl who enjoys hanging out in the apartment and being part of whatever you’re doing. Whether you're relaxing on the couch, working from home, or having a quiet night in, she just wants to be your little shadow.

She’s looking for a forever home where she can give lots of love. If you're looking for a sweet, affectionate companion who will happily snuggle up beside you and make you feel very loved, Pumpkin may be your girl. 🐾❤️

﻿Pumpkin is approximately 0y 11m 25d old and may be 34 to 38 pounds when fully grown. They are microchipped and up to date on all age-appropriate medical care. Their breed is unknown as we have not had a DNA test done.

Although our dogs are listed as unknown breed, buildings with specific dog restrictions typically enforce their rules based on what breeds a dog appears to resemble. It's always important to keep that in mind and know your building's policies before adopting a dog.

This dog is available for adoption through Muddy Paws Rescue. If you're interested in adopting, the first thing you should do is begin the registration process at www.muddypawsrescue.org. If you are already a registered adopter with Muddy Paws Rescue, please email us at adoptionmeetings@muddypawsrescue.org.
